Shamrock Pretzel Treats

Ingredients

  • Green m&ms
  • Pretzel Snaps
  • Green Writing Icing found at Target
  • Rolo chocolates

Instructions

  • Preheat oven to 250 degrees F.
  • On a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper, lay out the pretzels in rows.
  • Unwrap the rolos and place one on each.
  • Bake for 2-3 minutes.
  • Press 3 green m&ms on each pretzel. Stick in the fridge for 30 minutes to an hour.
  • Make the shamrock stem using the green cookie icing tube. Chill and enjoy!
